lines: Снимаем на RED V-RAPTOR. Анаморфот Laowa Proteus.
Обрати внимание. Качество другое. Чистые тени. Мягкие цвета. Глобальный затвор — никаких искажений при быстром движении. Великий горизонт.
Но здесь и другой объектив. Который идеально подходит для камеры RED. Блики горизонтальные. Полосы света. Анаморфот.
Покрытие держит контраст. Не перекрывает кадр.
Отлично, вот так снимает RED. Сейчас — другая камера. У каждой камеры свой характер.
raw:
Hyperrealistic cinematic documentary, indistinguishable from real footage. Vertical 9:16 aspect ratio. One continuous 30-second take, one uninterrupted shot, no cuts, no edits, unstabilized handheld camera, no stabilization whatsoever.

The entire scene is shot on a RED V-RAPTOR 8K VV from <<<image_1>>> with a Laowa Proteus 2x Anamorphic lens from <<<image_2>>>. This is the camera and lens through which the audience sees everything — the camera that is filming the scene. Every visual effect described below — the anamorphic flares, the horizontal streaks of light, the oval bokeh, the edge distortion — comes from this shooting lens. This is not the camera held by Alexander. This is not the lens shown by John. This is the optical system through which the entire scene is captured.

Separately, Alexander holds a RED V-RAPTOR in his hands, and John holds an open case with Laowa Proteus lenses. These are props — physical objects in the scene. They have no optical effects on them. No flares, no streaks, no anamorphic distortions appear on these objects. They are just cameras and lenses as things.

RED V-RAPTOR 8K VV: 8K full-frame global shutter sensor, 17+ stops of dynamic range, Extended Highlights for up to 20+ stops, large format global shutter with no rolling shutter artifacts or jelly effects during fast motion, REDCODE RAW, natural skin tones, precise color reproduction, clean shadows, uncompromising low-light performance, smooth highlight roll-off, extended highlight retention even in extreme light.

Laowa Proteus 2x Anamorphic lens: constant 2x squeeze ratio for cinematic ultra-widescreen results, elliptical bokeh, signature horizontal flares with a silver flare option that changes color according to the light source. The flare appears as horizontal streaks of light when the sun hits the glass, creating a controlled, cinematic lens flare rather than a washed-out image. The lens creates a subtle distortion at the edges, a vintage anamorphic character with modern sharpness, low focus breathing, and pleasant oval highlights in out-of-focus areas.

When the camera turns toward the sun, a horizontal streak of light appears across the image — a thin, blue-silver line stretching from one edge of the frame to the other. It is not a dot, not a circle, not a lens spot — it is a flat horizontal flare, the signature of an anamorphic lens. The streak pulses slightly, changes color from blue to silver as the camera moves, then retracts and disappears when the sun leaves the frame. It appears directly on the image, not on any object in the scene. This is the optical character of the shooting lens, visible only through the camera that captures the scene.

Natural exposure shifts, brief focus hunting during fast movements, horizon tilted, camera hand repositioning, breathing audible and visible in the frame rhythm. Real human behavior, no staged acting, natural micro-expressions, constant subtle movement. All dialogue in clear, native Russian, perfect pronunciation, natural intonation, as spoken by native Russian speakers. No accent, no foreign inflection, no robotic delivery.

The camera is handheld, unstabilized. The operator is never visible in frame — no hands, no body, no face. Every mention of the operator refers only to the behavior of the camera. The audience only sees what the camera sees.

Location: exactly as in <<<image_4>>> and <<<image_5>>> — the embankment of the Moskva River near the parking area, with a distant view of Moscow State University. Take only the location itself: no people, no poses from the references. Ignore any people present. Use only the space, architecture, ground, parapet, water, sky, and weather. The rain has just stopped, the sun is coming out. Wet asphalt, puddles reflecting the sky and the building. The parapet glistens. Moisture in the air. Light steam rises faintly from the warming asphalt, thin and barely visible. Sunlight breaks through the clouds in soft rays, occasional lens flares. Clouds move slowly, light shifts across the scene, shadows drift. No trees, no leaves on the asphalt. A light wind blows across the embankment — it moves hair, flutters clothes, ripples puddles slightly, keeps the air alive.

Alexander, matching <<<image_6>>>, stands near the main pickup from <<<image_3>>>. He holds the RED V-RAPTOR from <<<image_1>>> in his left hand. John, matching <<<image_7>>>, stands beside him, holding an open case with the Laowa Proteus 2x Anamorphic lenses from <<<image_2>>>. Alexander's face shows a slight redness and a small scrape on the right side only — a mark from a recent hit, no blood, no cut, just a light bruise forming under the skin, like a fresh impact. He holds a bag of ice in his right hand, pressing it to the right side of his face. He turns to the camera and says in clear, native Russian, perfect pronunciation, natural intonation: «Снимаем на RED V-RAPTOR. Анаморфот Laowa Proteus.» He speaks directly to the camera, calm, confident. The wind moves his damp hair and clothes.

As soon as he finishes the line, Alexander sets the camera down on the wet asphalt. John sets the open lens case down on the ground next to it. The camera moves in close, showing the RED V-RAPTOR on the ground, the lens case beside it, the lenses inside resting in foam cutouts. The operator approaches — the frame moves closer to the lenses in the case, then a close-up of a single lens as John lifts it briefly to show it, turning it slowly in the light. The lens is shown as a physical object — just glass, metal, and the reflection of the sky. No flares, no streaks, no anamorphic effects on the lens itself. The frame holds on the lens for a beat, then pulls back.

Then, without warning, John drops into a fighting stance — a classic Bruce Lee pose. He raises his leg high in a precise roundhouse kick, moving with the speed and control of Bruce Lee. Alexander shifts into a mixed martial arts stance. They explode into a fight — real, gritty, high-impact. John moves like Bruce Lee: fast, precise, controlled, with high kicks and sharp strikes. Alexander moves like an MMA fighter: grounded, heavy, powerful, with clinches, throws, and heavy punches. They exchange kicks and punches on the wet asphalt, slipping slightly, catching balance. Water splashes under their feet. Full contact — the sound of impact is audible through their breath and reactions. Alexander grabs John by the collar and drives him back, slamming him against the pickup. He pins him, starts punching. John headbutts him from below — Alexander staggers back. John kicks him in the chest. The fight is brutal, fast, and cinematic.

The operator is not afraid — the camera moves in extremely close during the clinch, a tight close-up of Alexander's face as he is pinned, then John's face as he is hit. The camera runs around them, circling, ducking, dropping low and shooting upward from waist level, tilting the horizon violently. The frame breathes with every move. When a punch flies too close, the camera jerks back, the frame drops, the focus slips, then recovers. The camera stumbles on a curb, the horizon tilts badly, then corrects. The operator's reflection briefly appears in a puddle — a dark silhouette, gone in a split second. The camera bumps into a fighter's back during a throw, the frame jolts, then recovers. Focus hunts constantly, losing and catching the action.

At one point, John grabs a car door and swings it, trying to hit Alexander like Jackie Chan — the door slams, misses, the frame shakes. The sun breaks through the clouds again — the shooting lens catches the light, and a horizontal silver flare streaks across the frame from the edge, changing color as it moves, creating a cinematic, controlled anamorphic effect on the image itself. A cloud passes, the light shifts for two seconds, then returns. Steam rises faintly from the wet asphalt. The shadow of the truck moves. A glare flashes off the wet ground and briefly blinds the shooting lens.

Alexander tries to keep talking through the fight, explaining, but his words break up between breaths and dodges. He says in clear, native Russian, perfect pronunciation, natural intonation: «Обрати внимание. Качество другое. Чистые тени. Мягкие цвета. Глобальный затвор — никаких искажений при быстром движении. Великий горизонт.» He blocks a punch mid-sentence. He says in clear, native Russian, perfect pronunciation, natural intonation: «Но здесь и другой объектив. Который идеально подходит для камеры RED. Блики горизонтальные. Полосы света. Анаморфот.» He dodges a kick, stumbles, recovers. He says in clear, native Russian, perfect pronunciation, natural intonation: «Покрытие держит контраст. Не перекрывает кадр.»

The fight slows for a second. Alexander blocks a punch, laughs shortly, nods at John — good one. He wipes sweat from his forehead with the back of his hand. He steps toward the camera, breathing hard, wiping his mouth, and says in clear, native Russian, perfect pronunciation, natural intonation: «Отлично, вот так снимает RED. Сейчас — другая камера. У каждой камеры свой характер.»

He finishes the line. Behind him, John runs up, preparing to strike. Alexander, without turning around, anticipates the movement — throws his leg back in a kick to the chest. John blocks, pushes off, but manages to catch Alexander's leg. He sharply goes for a grapple, locks the leg. Alexander, in pain, taps the ground three times. John releases. Alexander falls, laughs, holds his leg. John stands over him, breathing hard, smiling. The scene ends.

note.title: Объектив и горизонтальный блик
bullets: constant 2x squeeze ratio, elliptical bokeh, signature horizontal flares with a silver flare option that changes color: свойства анаморфота словами.

Описание блика — три слоя защиты. Форма: a thin, blue-silver line stretching from one edge of the frame to the other. Отрицание: It is not a dot, not a circle, not a lens spot — it is a flat horizontal flare. Поведение: The streak pulses slightly, changes color from blue to silver as the camera moves, then retracts and disappears.
It appears directly on the image, not on any object in the scene: местоположение эффекта. Этот приём решает ошибку первой попытки.
When the camera turns toward the sun: блик привязан к движению камеры. Пожалуй, самое важное: эффект оптики появляется как реакция на свет, а не висит «по умолчанию».
Концовка блока стандартная: дефекты, живое поведение, русская речь без акцента.

В репликах остались странные слова (например, «Великий горизонт»). Русский текст в «ёлочках» озвучивается буквально; в гайде мы оставляем оригинал как есть.

note.title: Финал
bullets: Приём «рифмы» с Кадром 2: John нападает сзади после реплики про «другую камеру». Alexander реагирует ногой, John ловит и берёт на болевой, Alexander хлопает по земле.

Финал описан коротко: The scene ends. В видео кадр заканчивается тем, что Alexander лежит на асфальте, а John стоит над ним. Здесь конец короче, чем в Кадре 2: если нужна пауза с тишиной и звуком за кадром, её стоит прописать так же подробно.
Это последний из трёх кадров: третья камера показана, тема закрыта.
